people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
translations.bsb: He placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
translations.kjv: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
translations.asv: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. And Jehovah gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
